summary: Benchmark 2026-V22 Mortgage Trust filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a commercial mortgage pass-through certificates issuance under its shelf registration. On May 26, 2026, the depositor caused the issuance of $650.5M public and $79.4M private certificates, plus an uncertificated risk retention interest, pursuant to a pooling and servicing agreement. The filing details underwriting agreements with multiple firms, but no special-situation event such as an acquisition or restructuring is present. This is a routine asset-backed securities takedown with no strategic corporate transaction, thus no special situation classification applies.
